name: recipe-webapp

dependencies.name: recipe-api
dependencies.description: Create, edit, search and delete recipes; manage the meal plan and shopping list.

dependencies.name: recipe-import-agent
dependencies.description: Extract a structured recipe draft from pasted text or a recipe URL for the Cook to review.

description: The single-page app a Cook uses to keep their recipe collection: create, browse, search, favorite and delete recipes; import a recipe via the agent and review the draft; plan meals for the week; and manage the generated shopping list. Holds no business data itself — everything is read from and written to recipe-api and recipe-import-agent.
